mustFindings.requirement: No overselling under concurrency; ErrOutOfStock when short

mustScenarios.risk: Reserving exactly 10 units must succeed, but qty >= 10 rejects it (off-by-one at the upper bound)
Quantities 0, -1 and 11 are rejected with ErrInvalidQuantity; 1 is accepted
Two concurrent reservations for the last unit: exactly one succeeds, the other gets ErrOutOfStock and stock stays at 0
An unconfirmed reservation older than 15 minutes is released and its units return to stock
A confirmed reservation is never released, even after 15 minutes

forbidden.description: Waitlists and back-order notifications exist in neither the issue nor the code

notes: AC3 is contradicted at the boundary (qty >= 10 rejects 10 units) and AC2 is absent: expires_at is stored but nothing releases expired reservations.
